# update

Update profile name or default environment

## Usage

```
ppds auth update [options]
```

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--environment` | `-env` | `string` |  | Default environment (ID, URL, unique name, or partial name) |
| `--index` | `-i` | `int` |  | The index of the profile to update |
| `--name` | `-n` | `string` |  | The name to give this profile (max 30 characters) |
